tools.name: get_foodly_overview
tools.description: What Foodly does for food businesses and diners, its web dashboard, and how payments work in each region.

tools.name: find_foodly_region
tools.description: Which Foodly region, plans and page apply to a country. Accepts an ISO code (MX) or a name in English, Spanish or Portuguese (Mexico, México).

tools.name: get_foodly_plans
tools.description: Foodly's plans and prices for one region, with what each plan includes.

tools.name: get_foodly_faq
tools.description: The questions food businesses ask most about Foodly in one region, with the answers.

tools.name: get_foodly_start
tools.description: How a food business starts with Foodly: app download links, the web dashboard and how to subscribe.

tools.name: find_restaurants
tools.description: Restaurants, bars, cafés and caterers on Foodly near a point, nearest first, optionally matching a dish, cuisine or name. Foodly is new, so there may be few or none.

tools.name: get_restaurant
tools.description: One Foodly restaurant: what it is, where, opening hours, phone, rating, whether it takes table reservations, and the packages it sells (cakes, catering, events).

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: A Foodly restaurant's menu: sections, dishes and drinks available today, with prices, sizes and declared allergens. Names are in the restaurant's language.

tools.name: get_table_times
tools.description: The times a Foodly restaurant has free for a table on one day, in the restaurant's local time. Booking is done in the Foodly app and the restaurant confirms it.
